description: Source code implementing ASN.1 BER to DER conversion and ASN.1 string parsing functions in OpenSSL's BoringSSL library.

methods.name: cbs_find_ber
methods.description: Walks an ASN.1 structure to find indefinite length elements or constructed strings.

methods.name: cbs_get_eoc
methods.description: Checks if the CBS begins with an End-Of-Contents (EOC) marker and advances past it.

methods.name: cbs_convert_ber
methods.description: Converts BER data to DER, handling indefinite length elements and concatenating constructed strings.

methods.name: CBS_asn1_ber_to_der
methods.description: Converts ASN.1 BER encoded data to DER encoding, using the above functions.

methods.name: CBS_get_asn1_implicit_string
methods.description: Parses ASN.1 implicit string types, including constructed strings, into a contiguous buffer.
